comparison: Zero-SVD Tikhonov smoothing immediately fixed all 4 shallow Tier-1 equilibrium failures from unified-v6.
conclusion: unified-v7 passed all numerically completed required Tier-1 tasks (flipping model_ae_gan_multimodal, model_vae_hard, precision_gaussian_fp32, and precision_gaussian_nvfp4 from FAIL to PASS via exact zero-SVD Tikhonov-smoothed Quintic), but five_word_joint_smoke timed out (>900s wall-time budget due to extra Y matmuls on 170x256/256x256 layers over 20k steps), gating Tier 2; stretch interp_sparse_arc reached interp_hq=0.7879 (vs >=0.80) under residual th_g clamp in delta_g_max.

decision_outcomes.reuse_note: Compatible original receipts; overlapping readouts are not independent runs or additive costs

hypothesis: Unchanged global clock-free zero-SVD zero-autograd.grad unified-v7 unifies all 4 Laws across discriminator_stability Tiers 1-3: preserving 13/13 counted Tier-1 gates, 7/7 held Tier-2 gates, 3/3 100-mode lattices (grid100, rotated100, staggered100), 4/4 discrete images, 6/6 vectors, Tier-3 14k continuation (ring_extension) & zero_tanh_rail_escape, and lifting conditional reverse diffusion chains (model_ddgan_*_chain) via cross-batch sufficient-statistics BLP alignment under protocol seed 0.
next_action: In unified-v8: restrict augmented (X,Y) Tikhonov to m_dim<=64 (unlocking five_word_joint_smoke well under budget), scale s_prior by 128/len(rows) (restoring t3_iso_scale_mass_8x=0.66), and drop residual th_g from delta_g_max (lifting interp_sparse_arc past 0.80), then run full Tiers 1-3.

study.competing_explanation: If unifying all 4 Laws in strictly 0 torch.autograd.grad and 0 torch.linalg.svd/eigh/pinv calls introduces cross-law interference, unified-v7 will regress counted Tier-1 gates, held Tier-2 gates, 100-mode lattices, discrete images, vector/conditional chains, or Tier-3 14k continuation relative to unified-v3 (34/41 Tier 1-2 PASS).
